journey.name: Demo shows a sample list of masked emails
journey.description: From the welcome screen, Try demo opens a local sample list. Nothing is sent to Fastmail.

actions.action: Verify that the welcome screen with a "Try demo" button is shown
Verify that a tutorial card titled "Your masked emails" with "Skip" and "Next" is visible
Verify that the heading "Masked" and the summary "8 active · 10 total" are visible
Verify that the banner "Demo mode — changes won't be saved" is visible
Verify that filter chips "All", "Active", "Off" and "Archived" are visible
Verify that the address "sharp.flame138@fastmask.com" is visible in the list
Verify that the list now shows exactly one mask and the "Archived" chip is selected
